pages.name: CLI-Runner
pages.desc: A method to run two commands that are normally run via terminal.  Instead of working in the error-prone terminal interface, enjoy two simple HTML forms that not only run the commands, but automate the normalization of the media links upon submission.  Twitter/X media can be retrieved using the yt-dlp form, and all other types of media can be retrieved via the 'ffmpeg' form.
